inventory.symbols: Root-provided complete math/text defineSymbol source data; original token preserved for wide mathematical alphabet font selection.

semantics.lexer: Control words [A-Za-z@]+ consume following whitespace; control symbols, escaped space, TeX comments, verb delimiters, combining characters and source offsets retained. Invalid characters explicitly rejected.
semantics.macros: Lazy token queue, request-local stacked namespace, numbered/delimited arguments, local/global def/gdef/edef/xdef, newcommand/renewcommand/providecommand, let, selected context expansion. Macro invocations inherit original position and substituted arguments retain theirs.
mathFamilies: operators, explicit limits and operator names
fonts, text with embedded math, four styles and sizes, mathchoice
arrays, matrix variants, align/gather/equation/cases families, row gaps/rules and arraystretch
href static content/url text, without interactive metadata
budgets: queued/initial token bound derived from max_nodes
semantics.units: Source 15 absolute/relative TeX units; native dimensions require finite numeric values.
semantics.security: No eval, exec, JS interpreter, HTML/DOM or network/resource fetching. Unknown controls and environments raise ParseError. Trust does not authorize execution.
semantics.positions: Python codepoint input offsets; no claim that offsets are UTF16 indices.

limitations: P1 was compile/import/signature only. Current P3 parser/macros targeted tests passed; no full-suite/render acceptance claimed.
No full KaTeX compatibility percentage is claimed. Source registration-to-family mapping is not measured branch coverage.
Unsupported registered names and three pending dynamic macros are preserved in the inventory. Static macros invoking them fail explicitly.

Remaining macro corners: def parameter-text hash-before-brace special case, futurelet and exhaustive optional/group cases. Scoped active definitions and ordinary/edef noexpand branches now have targeted source regressions.

Automatic equation numbering/tags and CD remain unimplemented. Source equation/split tab bounds and default non-strict array warning behavior have targeted tests; exhaustive strict/mode combinations remain unverified.
Parser interface currently lacks displayMode/strict/leqno/fleqn options; root layout Options selects visual display style. KaTeX display-only environment restrictions are not asserted equivalent.
Nested text/math switch supports dollar; explicit parenthesis/bracket mode delimiters remain unsupported.
HTML class/id/style/data and includegraphics explicitly reject rather than producing misleading success. href/url retain static text only.
Native parser accepts some direct semantic aliases in addition to source macro rewrites. Complete macro registration inventory beyond main macros.ts is owned by root.
Unsupported literal symbols/codepoints in downstream font metrics must remain an explicit layout error; parser does not substitute a system font.
